title: 試験に出る N1・N2 文法

items.q: 彼は、このごろ急に日本語が＿＿＿。
items.qr: Kare wa, konogoro kyuu ni nihongo ga ___.
items.en: His Japanese has suddenly got good lately.
items.hi: हाल में उसकी जापानी अचानक अच्छी हो गई है।
items.gu: હમણાં તેનું જાપાની અચાનક સારું થઈ ગયું છે.
items.why: このごろ急に signals a change, and 上手 is a な-adjective → 上手になった. 上手だった has no change; 上手にした needs someone to make it so (and を, not が).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 「いつもおきれいですね」と言ったとたん、彼女の顔が＿＿＿。
items.qr: "Itsumo okirei desu ne" to itta totan, kanojo no kao ga ___.
items.en: The moment I said "You always look lovely", her face went red.
items.hi: जैसे ही मैंने कहा "आप हमेशा बहुत सुंदर लगती हैं", उसका चेहरा लाल हो गया।
items.gu: જેવું મેં કહ્યું "તમે હંમેશાં ખૂબ સુંદર લાગો છો", તેનો ચહેરો લાલ થઈ ગયો.
items.why: 〜たとたん ("the moment…") needs a sudden change → い-adjective 赤い → 赤くなった. ×赤いになった mixes the な-adjective rule; 赤かった states a fact, not a change.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 漢字が難しくて全然覚えられない。いったいいつ＿＿＿のだろうか。
items.qr: Kanji ga muzukashikute zenzen oboerarenai. Ittai itsu ___ no darou ka.
items.en: Kanji are so hard that I can't remember them at all. When on earth will I be able to write them?
items.hi: कांजी इतने कठिन हैं कि बिल्कुल याद नहीं होते। आख़िर मैं इन्हें कब लिख पाऊँगा?
items.gu: કાંજી એટલા અઘરા છે કે બિલકુલ યાદ નથી રહેતા. આખરે હું તે ક્યારે લખી શકીશ?

opts.en: come to be able to write

items.why: A new ability to be gained → potential verb + ようになる. A verb can't take になる directly (×書けるになる), and plain 書ける loses the "when will it change?" meaning.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: このボタンを押すと、テレビの音が＿＿＿ます。
items.qr: Kono botan o osu to, terebi no oto ga ___ masu.
items.en: When you press this button, the TV gets louder.
items.hi: यह बटन दबाने पर टीवी की आवाज़ तेज़ हो जाती है।
items.gu: આ બટન દબાવવાથી ટીવીનો અવાજ મોટો થઈ જાય છે.
items.why: The subject is 音が and ます is printed, so the stem 大きくなり fits: the sound changes by itself when the button is pressed. 大きくします would need a person and を (音を); 大きいになり is ungrammatical.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: おなかが＿＿＿かもしれないから、海外旅行へ行く時は胃腸薬をもっていったほうがいいですよ。
items.qr: Onaka ga ___ kamo shirenai kara, kaigai ryokou e iku toki wa ichouyaku o motte itta hou ga ii desu yo.
items.en: You might get a stomach ache, so it's a good idea to take stomach medicine when you travel abroad.
items.hi: पेट में दर्द हो सकता है, इसलिए विदेश यात्रा पर जाते समय पेट की दवा साथ ले जाना अच्छा है।
items.gu: પેટમાં દુખાવો થઈ શકે, એટલે વિદેશ પ્રવાસે જતી વખતે પેટની દવા સાથે લઈ જવી સારી.
items.why: A possible future change (it isn't hurting yet) → 痛くなるかもしれない. 痛いかもしれない would mean "it may hurt right now"; the past 痛くなった doesn't fit an advance warning.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: ほかの人がおいしそうに食べているのを見ると、＿＿＿てしまう。
items.qr: Hoka no hito ga oishisou ni tabete iru no o miru to, ___ te shimau.
items.en: When I see other people eating with obvious enjoyment, I can't help wanting to eat too.
items.hi: दूसरों को मज़े से खाते देखकर मेरा भी खाने का मन करने लगता है।
items.gu: બીજાને મજાથી ખાતા જોઈને મારું પણ ખાવાનું મન થઈ જાય છે.

opts.t: 食べたくなっ(てしまう)
opts.hi: खाने का मन करने लगता है

opts.t: 食べるようになっ(てしまう)
opts.en: end up getting into the habit of eating
opts.hi: खाने की आदत पड़ जाती है

items.why: Seeing others eat triggers a change in desire → 食べたくなってしまう (〜たい is an い-adjective, so たい → たく + なる). The key adds たい, which the bracket doesn't show — that is the trick. 食べてしまう drops the "change" the exercise is about; 〜ようになる is for habits developing over time, not an instant urge.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: たばこを＿＿＿て、食べ物がおいしくなった。
items.qr: Tabako o ___ te, tabemono ga oishiku natta.
items.en: Since I stopped smoking, food tastes better.
items.hi: सिगरेट छोड़ने के बाद खाना स्वादिष्ट लगने लगा।
items.gu: સિગારેટ છોડ્યા પછી ખાવાનું સ્વાદિષ્ટ લાગવા માંડ્યું.

opts.t: 吸わないようになっ(て)

items.why: A habit that stopped → ない-form + なくなる: 吸わなくなって. 吸わなくて is just a negative て-form (no change); 吸わないようになって is possible in real Japanese but sounds like a deliberate effort, and the key gives 吸わなくなっ.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 今はまだテレビ番組がよく聞き取れない。＿＿＿たら、ニュースやドラマをたくさん見よう。
items.qr: Ima wa mada terebi bangumi ga yoku kikitorenai. ___ tara, nyuusu ya dorama o takusan miyou.
items.en: I still can't follow TV programmes well. Once I can, I'll watch lots of news and dramas.
items.hi: अभी मैं टीवी कार्यक्रम ठीक से समझ नहीं पाता। जब समझ पाने लगूँगा, तब ख़ूब समाचार और धारावाहिक देखूँगा।
items.gu: હજી હું ટીવી કાર્યક્રમો બરાબર સમજી શકતો નથી. જ્યારે સમજી શકતો થઈશ, ત્યારે ઘણા સમાચાર અને ધારાવાહિકો જોઈશ.

opts.t: 聞き取れるようになっ(たら)
opts.en: once I become able to follow

opts.t: 聞き取れるになっ(たら)

items.why: 今はまだ…聞き取れない sets up a future change in ability → potential + ようになったら. 聞き取れたら is grammatical but means "if (on some occasion) I manage to catch it", losing the "once I've improved" sense; ×聞き取れるになる is wrong.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: A：突然雨の音が＿＿＿ね。 B：本当だ。（外を見て）あ、どしゃぶりだよ。
items.qr: A: Totsuzen ame no oto ga ___ ne. B: Hontou da. (Soto o mite) A, doshaburi da yo.
items.en: A: The rain's suddenly got louder, hasn't it? B: You're right. (looking outside) Oh, it's pouring!
items.hi: A: अचानक बारिश की आवाज़ तेज़ हो गई, है न? B: सच में। (बाहर देखकर) अरे, मूसलाधार बारिश हो रही है!
items.gu: A: અચાનક વરસાદનો અવાજ વધી ગયો, નહીં? B: સાચે જ. (બહાર જોઈને) અરે, ધોધમાર વરસાદ છે!
items.why: 突然 + a change that has just happened → past 大きくなった. 大きいね describes a state without the "suddenly changed" sense; 大きくなるね would be a prediction.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 声が＿＿＿までカラオケで歌っていたなんて、すごいですね。
items.qr: Koe ga ___ made karaoke de utatte ita nante, sugoi desu ne.
items.en: You sang karaoke until you lost your voice? That's amazing.
items.hi: आवाज़ बैठ जाने तक कराओके गाते रहे? कमाल है!
items.gu: અવાજ બેસી ગયો ત્યાં સુધી કરાઓકે ગાતા રહ્યા? કમાલ છે!
items.why: まで ("until") marks the end point of a change → dictionary form 出なくなるまで. 出ないまで has no change; before まで the past 出なくなったまで is unnatural.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 映画『＿＿＿まで待って』は、名作である。
items.qr: Eiga "___ made matte" wa, meisaku de aru.
items.en: The film "Wait Until Dark" is a masterpiece.
items.hi: फ़िल्म "अँधेरा होने तक रुको" (Wait Until Dark) एक उत्कृष्ट कृति है।
items.gu: ફિલ્મ "અંધારું થાય ત્યાં સુધી રાહ જુઓ" (Wait Until Dark) એક ઉત્કૃષ્ટ કૃતિ છે.
items.why: "Wait until it gets dark" — a change reached at the end point まで → 暗くなるまで. 暗いまで has no change; 暗くするまで means someone darkens the room (a different film!).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: サッカーの試合で、選手たちは＿＿＿まで走り回り、終わった時はグラウンドに倒れてしまった。
items.qr: Sakkaa no shiai de, senshutachi wa ___ made hashirimawari, owatta toki wa guraundo ni taorete shimatta.
items.en: In the football match the players ran around until they couldn't run any more, and when it ended they collapsed on the pitch.
items.hi: फ़ुटबॉल मैच में खिलाड़ी तब तक दौड़ते रहे जब तक दौड़ने की ताक़त न रही, और ख़त्म होते ही मैदान पर गिर पड़े।
items.gu: ફૂટબૉલ મેચમાં ખેલાડીઓ દોડી ન શકાય ત્યાં સુધી દોડતા રહ્યા, અને મેચ પૂરી થતાં જ મેદાન પર ઢળી પડ્યા.
items.why: The end point is the moment their ability to run disappears → potential negative + なくなる: 走れなくなるまで. 走れないまで has no change; 走らなくなる would mean they chose to stop, not that they were exhausted.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 初めのうちはまじめに勉強していた学生が、だんだん勉強＿＿＿のはどうしてだろう。
items.qr: Hajime no uchi wa majime ni benkyou shite ita gakusei ga, dandan benkyou ___ no wa doushite darou.
items.en: Why is it that students who studied seriously at first gradually stop studying?
items.hi: शुरू में मन लगाकर पढ़ने वाले छात्र धीरे-धीरे पढ़ना क्यों छोड़ देते हैं?
items.gu: શરૂઆતમાં મન લગાવીને ભણતા વિદ્યાર્થીઓ ધીમે ધીમે ભણવાનું કેમ છોડી દે છે?
items.why: だんだん signals a gradual change, and the direction is negative (they used to study) → しなくなる. しない has no change; するようになる reverses the meaning.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: 患者：いつまで薬を飲み続けるんでしょうか。 医者：痛い間は飲んで下さい。＿＿＿たら、やめていいですよ。
items.qr: Kanja: Itsu made kusuri o nomitsuzukeru n deshou ka. Isha: Itai aida wa nonde kudasai. ___ tara, yamete ii desu yo.
items.en: Patient: How long should I keep taking the medicine? Doctor: Take it while it hurts. Once it stops hurting, you can stop.
items.hi: मरीज़: मुझे कब तक दवा लेते रहनी है? डॉक्टर: जब तक दर्द है, लीजिए। दर्द बंद हो जाए तो छोड़ सकते हैं।
items.gu: દર્દી: મારે ક્યાં સુધી દવા લેતા રહેવાની? ડૉક્ટર: દુખે ત્યાં સુધી લો. દુખાવો બંધ થાય પછી છોડી શકો છો.
items.why: The pain is there now (痛い間は) and the doctor talks about the moment it goes away → 痛くない → 痛くなくなったら. 痛くなかったら is a static condition (no change); 痛くなったら is the opposite change.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 変化表現 (expressions of change)

items.q: A：いいアパートが＿＿＿か。
items.qr: A: Ii apaato ga ___ ka.
items.en: A: Did you find a good apartment? (lit. Has a good apartment turned up?)
items.hi: A: क्या अच्छा फ़्लैट मिल गया?
items.gu: A: સારો ફ્લેટ મળી ગયો?
items.why: アパートが + blank: the apartment is the subject, so the intransitive 見つかる — polite past question 見つかりましたか.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: B：ええ、おかげさまで。でも、なかなか＿＿＿ませんでした。
items.qr: B: Ee, okagesama de. Demo, nakanaka ___ masen deshita.
items.en: B: Yes, thank you. But it took a long time to find one.
items.hi: B: हाँ, शुक्रिया। पर मिलने में काफ़ी वक़्त लगा।
items.gu: B: હા, આભાર. પણ મળવામાં ઘણો સમય લાગ્યો.
items.why: なかなか…ませんでした "it just wouldn't (turn up)" describes the situation, not an action — 見つかり + ませんでした. (The ます-stem is what fits before ませんでした.)
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: 友達がいろいろ探して、＿＿＿くれたんです。
items.qr: Tomodachi ga iroiro sagashite, ___ kureta n desu.
items.en: A friend looked all over and found one for me.
items.hi: एक दोस्त ने बहुत ढूँढा और मेरे लिए ढूँढ निकाला।
items.gu: એક મિત્રે ઘણું શોધ્યું અને મારા માટે શોધી આપ્યો.
items.why: A person (友達が) did the searching, and 〜てくれた is a favour done by someone — transitive 見つけて.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：そうですか。＿＿＿て、よかったですね。
items.qr: A: Sou desu ka. ___ te, yokatta desu ne.
items.en: A: I see. I'm glad you found one.
items.hi: A: अच्छा। मिल गया, यह अच्छा हुआ।
items.gu: A: એમ? મળી ગયો, એ સારું થયું.
items.why: The speaker is glad about the result (an apartment has been found), not about anyone's action — 見つかって、よかった. The て is printed, so the answer is 見つかっ.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：Bさん、会議が＿＿＿よ。早く行きましょう。
items.qr: A: B-san, kaigi ga ___ yo. Hayaku ikimashou.
items.en: A: B, the meeting is starting. Let's hurry.
items.hi: A: B जी, मीटिंग शुरू होने वाली है। जल्दी चलिए।
items.gu: A: B ભાઈ, મીટિંગ શરૂ થવાની છે. જલદી ચાલો.
items.why: 会議が — the meeting is the subject, so 始まる; polite non-past 始まります for an imminent event.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: B：すみませんが、先に＿＿＿いただけませんか。すぐ行きますので。
items.qr: B: Sumimasen ga, saki ni ___ itadakemasen ka. Sugu ikimasu node.
items.en: B: Sorry, but could you start without me? I'll be right there.
items.hi: B: माफ़ कीजिए, क्या आप पहले शुरू कर देंगे? मैं अभी आता हूँ।
items.gu: B: માફ કરજો, તમે પહેલાં શરૂ કરી દેશો? હું હમણાં આવું છું.
items.why: 〜ていただけませんか asks a person to act, so the transitive 始めて (会議を始める).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：わかりました。じゃ、先に＿＿＿います。
items.qr: A: Wakarimashita. Ja, saki ni ___ imasu.
items.en: A: All right. We'll go ahead and start, then.
items.hi: A: ठीक है। तो हम पहले शुरू कर देते हैं।
items.gu: A: સારું. તો અમે પહેલાં શરૂ કરી દઈએ છીએ.
items.why: A is talking about what we will do (先に始めている "we'll have started") — the speaker acts, so 他動詞 始めて. 始まっています would describe the meeting itself, not A's promise.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：このびんのふた、どうしても＿＿＿んです。
items.qr: A: Kono bin no futa, doushitemo ___ n desu.
items.en: A: The lid of this jar just won't open.
items.hi: A: इस बोतल का ढक्कन किसी भी तरह नहीं खुल रहा।
items.gu: A: આ બરણીનું ઢાંકણું કોઈ રીતે ખૂલતું નથી.
items.why: The lid is the topic and it resists — "it won't open" → 開かない. (開けない would mean "I don't open it", and 開けられない "I can't open it" is a different verb form.)
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: Bさん、＿＿＿みてください。
items.qr: B-san, ___ mite kudasai.
items.en: B, could you try opening it?
items.hi: B जी, ज़रा खोलकर देखिए।
items.gu: B ભાઈ, જરા ખોલી જુઓ.
items.why: A request to B (〜てみてください) — B must act on the lid: 開けて.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: B：ええ……。はい、＿＿＿よ。
items.qr: B: Ee…. Hai, ___ yo.
items.en: B: Hmm… There, it's open.
items.hi: B: हम्म…… लीजिए, खुल गया।
items.gu: B: હમ્મ…… લો, ખૂલી ગયું.
items.why: B reports the result — "it's open now" — with the intransitive 開きました. Japanese prefers the 自動詞 when announcing a result rather than boasting "I opened it".
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：洗面道具、かばんに＿＿＿？
items.qr: A: Senmen dougu, kaban ni ___?
items.en: A: Did you put your toiletries in the bag?
items.hi: A: टॉयलेट का सामान बैग में रख लिया?
items.gu: A: નહાવા-ધોવાનો સામાન બૅગમાં મૂકી દીધો?
items.why: A asks whether B did it — the toiletries are the (omitted を) object: 入れた. 入った would ask whether they fit.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: B：あ、まだ。＿＿＿の、忘れてた。
items.qr: B: A, mada. ___ no, wasureteta.
items.en: B: Oh, not yet. I forgot to put them in.
items.hi: B: अरे, अभी नहीं। रखना भूल गया था।
items.gu: B: અરે, હજી નહીં. મૂકવાનું ભૂલી ગયો હતો.
items.why: "I forgot to (do it)" — the forgotten thing is B's own action: 入れるの.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: ……うーん、かばんがもういっぱいで、＿＿＿よ。どうしよう。
items.qr: …Uun, kaban ga mou ippai de, ___ yo. Dou shiyou.
items.en: …Hmm, the bag's already full — they won't fit. What shall I do?
items.hi: ……हम्म, बैग पहले से भरा है, सामान नहीं समा रहा। क्या करूँ?
items.gu: ……હમ્મ, બૅગ પહેલેથી ભરેલી છે, સામાન સમાતો નથી. શું કરું?
items.why: The bag is full, so the things won't go in no matter what — a situation, not a choice: 入らない.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：じゃ、こっちのバッグに＿＿＿てあげるよ。かして。
items.qr: A: Ja, kocchi no baggu ni ___ te ageru yo. Kashite.
items.en: A: Then I'll put them in this bag for you. Give them here.
items.hi: A: तो मैं इन्हें इस बैग में रख देता हूँ। लाओ, दो।
items.gu: A: તો હું આને આ બૅગમાં મૂકી આપું. લાવ, આપ.
items.why: 〜てあげる is a favour A does — transitive 入れて (the て is printed, so the answer is 入れ).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：今度、消費税が＿＿＿んですってね。
items.qr: A: Kondo, shouhizei ga ___ n desu tte ne.
items.en: A: I hear the consumption tax is going up this time.
items.hi: A: सुना है इस बार उपभोग कर (सेल्स टैक्स) बढ़ने वाला है।
items.gu: A: સાંભળ્યું છે આ વખતે ઉપભોગ કર (વેચાણ વેરો) વધવાનો છે.
items.why: 消費税が + blank, and B's reaction 困りましたね shows it is bad news → the tax goes up: 上がる.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: B：まったく、困りましたね。給料はぜんぜん＿＿＿んですからね。
items.qr: B: Mattaku, komarimashita ne. Kyuuryou wa zenzen ___ n desu kara ne.
items.en: B: Honestly, what a pain. And salaries aren't going up at all.
items.hi: B: सच में, बड़ी मुसीबत है। तनख़्वाह तो ज़रा भी नहीं बढ़ती।
items.gu: B: ખરેખર, મોટી તકલીફ છે. પગાર તો જરાય વધતો નથી.
items.why: ぜんぜん + negative, and the complaint is that pay doesn't rise → 上がらない (給料は as topic, intransitive).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: A：むしろ＿＿＿ているんじゃないですか。不景気だから。
items.qr: A: Mushiro ___ te iru n ja nai desu ka. Fukeiki da kara.
items.en: A: If anything, aren't they going down? With the recession and all.
items.hi: A: बल्कि घट ही रही है न? मंदी जो है।
items.gu: A: ઊલટું ઘટી રહ્યો છે ને? મંદી છે એટલે.
items.why: むしろ ("rather, if anything") + 不景気 → salaries are falling; the subject is still 給料, so intransitive 下がっている (the て is printed → 下がっ).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: B：政府も、経済の活性化ができないのなら、せめて税金ぐらい＿＿＿ほしいですよね。
items.qr: B: Seifu mo, keizai no kasseika ga dekinai no nara, semete zeikin gurai ___ hoshii desu yo ne.
items.en: B: If the government can't revive the economy, I wish they'd at least lower taxes.
items.hi: B: अगर सरकार अर्थव्यवस्था में जान नहीं डाल सकती, तो कम से कम टैक्स तो घटा दे।
items.gu: B: જો સરકાર અર્થતંત્રમાં જીવ ન લાવી શકે, તો ઓછામાં ઓછું કર તો ઘટાડે.
items.why: 〜てほしい directed at the government (an agent who can act on taxes) + せめて…ぐらい ("at least") → 下げて. Note the 第8日 くらい (b) "at least do that much" here: 税金ぐらい下げてほしい.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 自動詞、他動詞

items.q: 授業が終わったか終わらないかのうちに、＿＿＿。
items.qr: Jugyou ga owatta ka owaranai ka no uchi ni, ___.
items.en: The class had barely ended when the students started to leave.
items.hi: क्लास ख़त्म हुई न हुई कि छात्र जाने लगे।
items.gu: ક્લાસ પૂરો થયો ન થયો ત્યાં વિદ્યાર્થીઓ જવા લાગ્યા.

opts.t: 学生たちは帰り始めた

items.why: 〜か〜ないかのうちに narrates something that happened almost at the same moment, so it ends in a past fact (帰り始めた). A request (〜ないでください) is struck out by the book. To make a request, use 〜たらすぐ／〜次第.
items.unit: 「〜たらすぐ」のつづき

items.q: うちに帰ったとたん、＿＿＿。
items.qr: Uchi ni kaetta totan, ___.
items.en: The moment I got home, it started to rain.
items.hi: घर पहुँचते ही बारिश शुरू हो गई।
items.gu: ઘરે પહોંચતાં જ વરસાદ શરૂ થયો.
items.why: 〜たとたん is followed by a sudden, unexpected event (降り出した). A command (〜なさい) cannot follow it — the book strikes it out. "Do your homework as soon as you get home" would be 帰ったらすぐ宿題をしなさい.
items.unit: 「〜たらすぐ」のつづき

items.q: そのニュースを聞くや否やみんな＿＿＿。
items.qr: Sono nyuusu o kiku ya ina ya minna ___.
items.en: The instant they heard the news, everyone stood up.
items.hi: वह ख़बर सुनते ही सब उठ खड़े हुए।
items.gu: એ સમાચાર સાંભળતાં જ બધા ઊભા થઈ ગયા.
items.why: 〜や否や (formal, N1) links two actions happening one right after the other. "Not standing up" is not an action that can happen "the instant" — a negative ending is struck out.
items.unit: 「〜たらすぐ」のつづき

items.q: (彼は)国へ帰ったかと思ったら、＿＿＿。
items.qr: (Kare wa) kuni e kaetta ka to omottara, ___.
items.en: No sooner had he gone back home than he went off to study in Australia.
items.hi: अभी वह अपने देश लौटा ही था कि फ़ौरन फिर पढ़ने ऑस्ट्रेलिया चला गया।
items.gu: હજી તે વતન પાછો ફર્યો જ હતો કે તરત ફરી ભણવા ઑસ્ટ્રેલિયા ચાલ્યો ગયો.

opts.t: またすぐオーストラリアに留学した
opts.r: mata sugu oosutoraria ni ryuugaku shita
opts.en: immediately went to study in Australia

items.why: 〜たかと思ったら describes the speaker watching someone else do one thing and then, surprisingly fast, another. It needs a past observed event (留学した); a statement of one's own intention (〜つもりです) is struck out.
items.unit: 「〜たらすぐ」のつづき

items.q: (その男は)財布をとるが早いか、走って＿＿＿。
items.qr: (Sono otoko wa) saifu o toru ga hayai ka, hashitte ___.
items.en: The man had no sooner grabbed the wallet than he ran off.
items.hi: वह आदमी बटुआ झपटते ही दौड़कर भाग गया।
items.gu: એ માણસ પાકીટ ઝૂંટવતાં જ દોડીને ભાગી ગયો.
items.why: 〜が早いか (N1, written) narrates a quick sequence in the past. An invitation (〜ましょう) looks forward and is struck out.
items.unit: 「〜たらすぐ」のつづき

items.q: (その子は)私の顔を見るなり＿＿＿。
items.qr: (Sono ko wa) watashi no kao o miru nari ___.
items.en: The child burst into tears the moment she saw my face.
items.hi: वह बच्चा मेरा चेहरा देखते ही रो पड़ा।
items.gu: એ બાળક મારો ચહેરો જોતાં જ રડી પડ્યું.
items.why: 〜なり needs a sudden new action by the same subject right after the first (泣き出した "started crying"). 〜ていた describes an ongoing state, which cannot "begin the moment" — struck out.
items.unit: 「〜たらすぐ」のつづき

items.q: 川田さん、旅行のパンフレットがないんですか。じゃあ、中山さんが持っていますから、｛a 見せてあげてください。／ b 見せてもらってください。｝
items.qr: Kawada-san, ryokou no panfuretto ga nai n desu ka. Jaa, Nakayama-san ga motte imasu kara, {a misete agete kudasai. / b misete moratte kudasai.}
items.en: Kawada-san, you don't have the travel pamphlet? Well, Nakayama-san has one, so ask him to show it to you.
items.hi: कावादा-सान, आपके पास यात्रा का पैम्फ़लेट नहीं है? तो नाकायामा-सान के पास है, उनसे दिखवा लीजिए।
items.gu: કાવાદા-સાન, તમારી પાસે પ્રવાસનું પેમ્ફલેટ નથી? તો નાકાયામા-સાન પાસે છે, તેમની પાસેથી બતાવડાવી લો.

opts.t: 見せてあげてください。
見せてもらってください。
opts.en: please have him show it to you

items.why: The speaker is talking to Kawada, who lacks the pamphlet — Kawada is the receiver of the favour, Nakayama the giver. So "receive the favour of being shown" — 見せてもらって. a would tell Kawada to show something to someone, but he has nothing to show.
items.unit: 基本文法 · やる、あげる、もらう、くれる

items.q: 中山さん、川田さんに旅行のパンフレットを｛a 見せてあげてください。／ b 見せてもらってください。｝
items.qr: Nakayama-san, Kawada-san ni ryokou no panfuretto o {a misete agete kudasai. / b misete moratte kudasai.}
items.en: Nakayama-san, please show Kawada-san the travel pamphlet.
items.hi: नाकायामा-सान, कावादा-सान को यात्रा का पैम्फ़लेट दिखा दीजिए।
items.gu: નાકાયામા-સાન, કાવાદા-સાનને પ્રવાસનું પેમ્ફલેટ બતાવી દો.

opts.t: 見せてあげてください。
見せてもらってください。
opts.en: please have him show it to you

items.why: Now the speaker is talking to Nakayama, the one with the pamphlet: he is the giver, Kawada (marked with に) the receiver — 見せてあげて. With b, 川田さんに would become the giver ("have Kawada show it to you"), the reverse of the situation.
items.unit: 基本文法 · やる、あげる、もらう、くれる

items.q: 今、あの化粧品を買うと、ショッピングバッグを｛a くれますよ。／ b もらいますよ。｝
items.qr: Ima, ano keshouhin o kau to, shoppingu baggu o {a kuremasu yo. / b moraimasu yo.}
items.en: If you buy those cosmetics now, they'll give you a shopping bag.
items.hi: अभी वह कॉस्मेटिक ख़रीदोगे तो वे शॉपिंग बैग देंगे।
items.gu: અત્યારે એ કોસ્મેટિક ખરીદશો તો તેઓ શોપિંગ બેગ આપશે.
items.why: The unstated subject is the shop, giving to the customer (the listener, on "our" side) — くれます. もらいます would need the receiver as subject and states a plain fact about one's own action, which sounds odd as advice; もらえますよ ("you can get one") would have worked, but it is not an option.
items.unit: 基本文法 · やる、あげる、もらう、くれる

items.q: 中田さん、実はちょっとお願いがあるんですけど……。うちの息子に数学を｛a 教えてやっていただけないでしょうか。／ b 教えていただいてもらえないでしょうか。／ c 教えてあげていただかないでしょうか。｝
items.qr: Nakata-san, jitsu wa chotto onegai ga aru n desu kedo…. Uchi no musuko ni suugaku o {a oshiete yatte itadakenai deshou ka. / b oshiete itadaite moraenai deshou ka. / c oshiete agete itadakanai deshou ka.}
items.en: Nakata-san, actually I have a small favour to ask… Could you possibly teach my son maths?
items.hi: नाकाता-सान, दरअसल एक छोटी-सी गुज़ारिश है…… क्या आप मेरे बेटे को गणित पढ़ा देंगे?
items.gu: નાકાતા-સાન, ખરેખર એક નાની વિનંતી છે…… શું આપ મારા દીકરાને ગણિત શીખવી આપશો?

opts.t: 教えてやっていただけないでしょうか。
教えていただいてもらえないでしょうか。
教えてあげていただかないでしょうか。

items.why: Two favours stacked: Nakata teaches my son (a family member, so the humble 〜てやる), and I ask Nakata for that favour (〜ていただけないでしょうか — potential negative = polite request). b stacks two receiving verbs (いただいて＋もらえない); c uses 〜ていただかない (plain negative, not potential), which is not a request.
items.unit: 基本文法 · やる、あげる、もらう、くれる

items.q: 旅行中、花に水を｛a もらってくれる／ b あげてもらう／ c やってくれる｝人がいなくて、花を枯らしてしまいました。
items.qr: Ryokouchuu, hana ni mizu o {a moratte kureru / b agete morau / c yatte kureru} hito ga inakute, hana o karashite shimaimashita.
items.en: While I was travelling there was nobody to water my flowers for me, so they withered.
items.hi: यात्रा के दौरान मेरे फूलों को पानी देने वाला कोई नहीं था, इसलिए फूल सूख गए।
items.gu: પ્રવાસ દરમિયાન મારાં ફૂલોને પાણી પાનાર કોઈ નહોતું, એટલે ફૂલો સુકાઈ ગયાં.
items.why: Giving water to plants is 水をやる (やる is used for plants and animals), and the person would be doing it for me → やってくれる人. "水をもらう" means receiving water, which is the flowers' side, not a person's action; あげてもらう人 would make the person the receiver of a favour, which does not fit 人がいなくて.
items.unit: 基本文法 · やる、あげる、もらう、くれる

items.q: 鈴木：カタログを見ないと、何を注文すればいいのか、わかりませんね。 山中：じゃ、僕が｛a もらってきてくれますよ。／ b もらってきてあげますよ。／ c あげてきてくれますよ。｝あそこに置いてありましたから。
items.qr: Suzuki: Katarogu o minai to, nani o chuumon sureba ii no ka, wakarimasen ne. / Yamanaka: Ja, boku ga {a moratte kite kuremasu yo. / b moratte kite agemasu yo. / c agete kite kuremasu yo.} Asoko ni oite arimashita kara.
items.en: Suzuki: Without seeing the catalogue, I don't know what to order. Yamanaka: Then I'll go and get one for you. I saw some over there.
items.hi: सुज़ुकी: कैटलॉग देखे बिना पता नहीं चलेगा कि क्या ऑर्डर करें। यामानाका: तो मैं आपके लिए ले आता हूँ। वहाँ रखे हुए थे।
items.gu: સુઝુકી: કેટલોગ જોયા વિના ખબર નહીં પડે કે શું ઓર્ડર કરવું. યામાનાકા: તો હું તમારા માટે લઈ આવું છું. ત્યાં મૂકેલા હતા.

opts.t: もらってきてくれますよ。
もらってきてあげますよ。
opts.en: I'll go and get one for you
opts.hi: मैं आपके लिए ले आता हूँ
opts.gu: હું તમારા માટે લઈ આવું છું

opts.t: あげてきてくれますよ。

items.why: Yamanaka (僕が) will go, get a catalogue (もらう) and come back (〜てくる), as a favour for Suzuki (〜てあげる). くれる can never have 僕 as the giver, which rules out a and c; c also gets the direction of もらう／あげる backwards.
items.unit: 基本文法 · やる、あげる、もらう、くれる

items.q: 電車が遅れて、友達を30分も［待って／待たせて／待たされて］しまいました。
items.qr: Densha ga okurete, tomodachi o sanjuppun mo [matte / matasete / matasarete] shimaimashita.
items.en: The train was late, and I ended up keeping my friend waiting for a whole 30 minutes.
items.hi: ट्रेन लेट हो गई और मुझे दोस्त को पूरे 30 मिनट इंतज़ार करवाना पड़ा।
items.gu: ટ્રેન મોડી પડી અને મારે મિત્રને આખી 30 મિનિટ રાહ જોવડાવવી પડી.
items.why: My train was late, so I made my friend wait: 友達を + causative 待たせる. 友達を待って would mean I waited for him; 待たされて would make me the victim, but I was the late one.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 町が発展［する／される／させる］につれて、生活も豊かになってきた。
items.qr: Machi ga hatten [suru / sareru / saseru] ni tsurete, seikatsu mo yutaka ni natte kita.
items.en: As the town developed, people's lives also became more prosperous.
items.hi: जैसे-जैसे शहर का विकास हुआ, जीवन भी समृद्ध होता गया।
items.gu: જેમ જેમ શહેરનો વિકાસ થયો, તેમ જીવન પણ સમૃદ્ધ બનતું ગયું.
items.why: 発展する is intransitive ("develop"), and 町が is its subject, so the plain form is right. There is no agent doing the developing in this sentence; 町を発展させる would need someone as subject.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 彼は昔、強制的に化学兵器の研究を［して・されて・させられて］いたらしい。
items.qr: Kare wa mukashi, kyouseiteki ni kagaku heiki no kenkyuu o [shite / sarete / saserarete] ita rashii.
items.en: Apparently he was once forced to do research on chemical weapons.
items.hi: लगता है कि पहले उससे ज़बरदस्ती रासायनिक हथियारों पर शोध करवाया जाता था।
items.gu: લાગે છે કે પહેલાં તેની પાસે જબરદસ્તીથી રાસાયણિક હથિયારો પર સંશોધન કરાવાતું હતું.
items.why: 強制的に ("by force") + he is the one who did the research → he was made to do it: causative-passive させられる. 研究をされて would mean the research was done to him.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 高速道路が開通［して／されて／させられて］この辺りはとても便利になった。
items.qr: Kousoku douro ga kaitsuu [shite / sarete / saserarete] kono atari wa totemo benri ni natta.
items.en: The expressway opened, and this area has become very convenient.
items.hi: हाईवे खुल गया और यह इलाक़ा बहुत सुविधाजनक हो गया।
items.gu: હાઈવે ખૂલી ગયો અને આ વિસ્તાર બહુ સગવડભર્યો થઈ ગયો.
items.why: 開通する ("open to traffic") is intransitive, like 発展する in item 2. 道路が開通する is the normal expression; no passive.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 電気が発明［して／されて／させて］人間の生活はすっかり変わった。
items.qr: Denki ga hatsumei [shite / sarete / sasete] ningen no seikatsu wa sukkari kawatta.
items.en: Electricity was invented, and human life changed completely.
items.hi: बिजली का आविष्कार हुआ और इंसान का जीवन पूरी तरह बदल गया।
items.gu: વીજળીની શોધ થઈ અને માણસનું જીવન સંપૂર્ણ બદલાઈ ગયું.
items.why: 発明する is transitive — a person invents something. With electricity as the subject (電気が), the verb must be passive: 発明される. Contrast with items 2 and 4.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 最近の若者に関するニュースを聞いていると、［考えられる／考えさせる／考えさせられる］ことが多い。
items.qr: Saikin no wakamono ni kansuru nyuusu o kiite iru to, [kangaerareru / kangaesaseru / kangaesaserareru] koto ga ooi.
items.en: Listening to the news about young people these days, there is a lot that makes me stop and think.
items.hi: आजकल के युवाओं से जुड़ी ख़बरें सुनकर अक्सर सोचने पर मजबूर हो जाता हूँ।
items.gu: આજકાલના યુવાનો વિશેના સમાચાર સાંભળીને ઘણી વાર વિચારવા મજબૂર થઈ જાઉં છું.

opts.hi: सोचने पर मजबूर हो जाता हूँ

items.why: The listener (me) is the one who ends up thinking, triggered by the news — causative-passive 考えさせられる "it makes me think". 考えさせる would need the news as subject (ニュースが私に考えさせる); 考えられる means "is conceivable", not what is meant.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 動物の親子の特集番組を見ていて、いろいろと［教えた／教えられた／教えさせた］。
items.qr: Doubutsu no oyako no tokushuu bangumi o mite ite, iroiro to [oshieta / oshierareta / oshiesaseta].
items.en: Watching a special programme on animal parents and their young, I learned a lot (lit. I was taught many things).
items.hi: जानवरों और उनके बच्चों पर बने ख़ास कार्यक्रम को देखते हुए मुझे बहुत कुछ सीखने को मिला।
items.gu: પ્રાણીઓ અને તેમનાં બચ્ચાં પરનો ખાસ કાર્યક્રમ જોતાં મને ઘણું શીખવા મળ્યું.
items.why: The viewer receives lessons from what he watched → passive 教えられた ("I was taught a lot by it"). Same idea as item 6. I didn't teach anyone, nor make anyone teach.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: この小説を読んで、とても［感動した／感動された／感動させた］。
items.qr: Kono shousetsu o yonde, totemo [kandou shita / kandou sareta / kandou saseta].
items.en: I read this novel and was deeply moved.
items.hi: यह उपन्यास पढ़कर मैं बहुत भावुक हो गया।
items.gu: આ નવલકથા વાંચીને હું ખૂબ ભાવુક થઈ ગયો.
items.why: 感動する already means "be moved (emotionally)", with the person moved as subject. Unlike 考える／教える in items 6–7, no passive is needed. 感動させた would require the novel as subject (この小説は私を感動させた).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 子供のころ姉の着ていた洋服を［着られる／着させる／着させられる］のがとてもいやだった。
items.qr: Kodomo no koro ane no kite ita youfuku o [kirareru / kisaseru / kisaserareru] no ga totemo iya datta.
items.en: When I was a child, I really hated being made to wear my older sister's hand-me-down clothes.
items.hi: बचपन में मुझे दीदी के पहने हुए कपड़े पहनने पर मजबूर किया जाना बिल्कुल पसंद नहीं था।
items.gu: નાનપણમાં મને દીદીનાં પહેરેલાં કપડાં પહેરવા મજબૂર કરાતું એ જરાય ગમતું નહોતું.
items.why: いやだった shows I didn't want to; the parents made me wear them → causative-passive 着させられる. (Strictly, 着せられる is also used for "be dressed in"; the column keys 着させられる.)
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 大好きなバッグを妹に［取って／取られて／取らせて］しまった。
items.qr: Daisuki na baggu o imouto ni [totte / torarete / torasete] shimatta.
items.en: My favourite bag got taken by my younger sister.
items.hi: मेरा सबसे पसंदीदा बैग मेरी छोटी बहन ने ले लिया।
items.gu: મારી સૌથી ગમતી બૅગ મારી નાની બહેને લઈ લીધી.
items.why: 妹に + my own bag + てしまった (regret) = the "suffering" passive: 取られてしまった. 取らせて would mean I let her take it; 取って would make me the taker, but then 妹に makes no sense.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: お母さんが、赤ちゃんにミルクを［飲んで／飲まれて／飲ませて］いる。
items.qr: Okaasan ga, akachan ni miruku o [nonde / nomarete / nomasete] iru.
items.en: The mother is giving the baby milk (lit. making the baby drink milk).
items.hi: माँ बच्चे को दूध पिला रही है।
items.gu: મા બાળકને દૂધ પિવડાવે છે.
items.why: Mother (subject) + 赤ちゃんに (the one who actually drinks) + ミルクを → causative 飲ませる "give to drink". Hindi/Gujarati have the same causative pair: पीना → पिलाना, પીવું → પિવડાવવું.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 彼の不用意な発言は、その場の空気を悪く［した／された／させられた］。
items.qr: Kare no fuyoui na hatsugen wa, sono ba no kuuki o waruku [shita / sareta / saserareta].
items.en: His careless remark soured the atmosphere there.
items.hi: उसकी बेपरवाह टिप्पणी ने वहाँ का माहौल ख़राब कर दिया।
items.gu: તેની બેદરકાર ટિપ્પણીએ ત્યાંનું વાતાવરણ બગાડી નાખ્યું.
items.why: The remark is the subject and 空気を is the object: い-adj 〜く + する "make ~" in the active voice — 悪くした. Passive would need 空気が as subject.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: その政治家は、疑惑が発覚し、辞任を余儀なく［された／させた］。
items.qr: Sono seijika wa, giwaku ga hakkaku shi, jinin o yoginaku [sareta / saseta].
items.en: Suspicions about the politician came to light, and he was forced to resign.
items.hi: उस नेता पर लगे संदेह उजागर हुए और उसे इस्तीफ़ा देने पर मजबूर होना पड़ा।
items.gu: એ રાજકારણી પરની શંકાઓ બહાર આવી અને તેને રાજીનામું આપવા મજબૂર થવું પડ્યું.
items.why: The person who had to resign is the subject (その政治家は) → 〜を余儀なくされる "be compelled to ~" (N1, 第32日).
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 疑惑の発覚は、その政治家に辞任を余儀なく［された／させた］。
items.qr: Giwaku no hakkaku wa, sono seijika ni jinin o yoginaku [sareta / saseta].
items.en: The discovery of the suspicions forced the politician to resign.
items.hi: संदेह उजागर होने ने उस नेता को इस्तीफ़ा देने पर मजबूर कर दिया।
items.gu: શંકાઓ બહાર આવવાથી એ રાજકારણીને રાજીનામું આપવાની ફરજ પડી.
items.why: Now the cause is the subject (疑惑の発覚は) and the person is marked with に → causative 〜に…を余儀なくさせる. Compare with item 13: same fact, opposite viewpoint.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: まだ実家にいて、親に｛食べさせられて／食べさせてもらって｝いるので、ぜいたくはできない。
items.qr: Mada jikka ni ite, oya ni {tabesaserarete / tabesasete moratte} iru node, zeitaku wa dekinai.
items.en: I still live at my parents' home and they feed and support me, so I can't afford luxuries.
items.hi: मैं अभी भी माता-पिता के घर रहता हूँ और वही मेरा ख़र्च चलाते हैं, इसलिए ऐश नहीं कर सकता।
items.gu: હું હજી માતાપિતાના ઘરે રહું છું અને તેઓ જ મારો ખર્ચ ઉપાડે છે, એટલે મોજશોખ કરી શકતો નથી.
items.why: 親に食べさせてもらう = "my parents provide for me" — a favour I receive, hence the humble "can't be extravagant". 食べさせられる would mean being forced to eat something, which doesn't fit.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 予定がはっきりしたら、［知らせて／知られて／知って］ください。
items.qr: Yotei ga hakkiri shitara, [shirasete / shirarete / shitte] kudasai.
items.en: When your plans are clear, please let me know.
items.hi: जब आपका कार्यक्रम पक्का हो जाए, तो मुझे बता दीजिए।
items.gu: જ્યારે તમારો કાર્યક્રમ નક્કી થાય, ત્યારે મને જણાવજો.
items.why: 知らせる ("inform", originally the causative of 知る — "make someone know") + てください is the normal request. 知ってください would be "please know (it)", 知られてください makes no sense.
items.unit: 基本文法 · 受身、使役、使役受身

items.q: 新宿まで行く＿＿＿、電車に30分も乗らなければならない。
items.qr: Shinjuku made iku ___, densha ni sanjuppun mo noranakereba naranai.
items.en: To get to Shinjuku, you have to ride the train for a whole 30 minutes.
items.hi: शिंजुकु तक जाने के लिए ट्रेन में पूरे 30 मिनट बैठना पड़ता है।
items.gu: શિંજુકુ સુધી જવા માટે ટ્રેનમાં પૂરી 30 મિનિટ બેસવું પડે છે.
items.why: V-dict + には + necessity (〜なければならない) = "in order to ~, you need …" (purpose). のは／のが would make 行く the topic/subject of a sentence that never gets a matching predicate; とは expresses surprise or definition.
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: デパ地下＿＿＿、デパートの地下食料品売り場のことである。
items.qr: Depachika ___, depaato no chika shokuryouhin uriba no koto de aru.
items.en: "Depachika" means the basement food hall of a department store.
items.hi: "देपाचिका" का मतलब है डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर के बेसमेंट में खाने-पीने का बाज़ार।
items.gu: "દેપાચિકા" એટલે ડિપાર્ટમેન્ટ સ્ટોરના ભોંયરામાં આવેલું ખાદ્યપદાર્થોનું બજાર.
items.why: The sentence ends in 〜のことである, so it's a definition: 〜というのは〜のことだ (topic 2). ということは draws a conclusion from a previous statement ("so that means…"), not a definition of a word.
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: 遅くなると＿＿＿、そろそろ帰ります。
items.qr: Osoku naru to ___, sorosoro kaerimasu.
items.en: I'll be heading home soon, so that it doesn't get too late.
items.hi: कहीं ज़्यादा देर न हो जाए, इसलिए अब मैं चलता हूँ।
items.gu: ક્યાંક વધારે મોડું ન થઈ જાય, એટલે હવે હું નીકળું છું.
items.why: 〜といけないので = 〜ないように (topic 3): a precaution followed by the speaker's decision (帰ります). The て-form いけなくて can't introduce a volitional main clause; the other two strings aren't grammatical here.
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: 自転車は、近所（ ）買い物（ ）行く（ ）（ ）便利です。
items.qr: Jitensha wa, kinjo ( ) kaimono ( ) iku ( )( ) benri desu.
items.en: A bicycle is handy for going shopping in the neighbourhood.
items.hi: पास में ख़रीदारी करने जाने के लिए साइकिल सुविधाजनक है।
items.gu: નજીકમાં ખરીદી કરવા જવા માટે સાઇકલ અનુકૂળ છે.
items.why: Direction へ (近所へ), purpose に after an action noun (買い物に行く), and のに + 便利 "handy for". 近所で would describe where the shopping happens but clashes with 行く; ので (because) breaks the 便利 frame.
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: 新宿（ ）降りて、山手線（ ）乗りかえてください。
items.qr: Shinjuku ( ) orite, Yamanotesen ( ) norikaete kudasai.
items.en: Get off at Shinjuku and change to the Yamanote Line.
items.hi: शिंजुकु पर उतरकर यामानोते लाइन में बदल लीजिए।
items.gu: શિંજુકુ પર ઊતરીને યામાનોતે લાઇનમાં બદલી લો.

opts.en: (電車を降りる needs a vehicle)

items.why: The station where you get off takes で (新宿で降りる); the vehicle you leave takes を (電車を降りる), and the line you change onto takes に (〜に乗りかえる).
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: この道（ ）まっすぐ行って、二つ目の角（ ）右（ ）曲がってください。
items.qr: Kono michi ( ) massugu itte, futatsume no kado ( ) migi ( ) magatte kudasai.
items.en: Go straight along this road and turn right at the second corner.
items.hi: यह सड़क सीधे जाइए और दूसरे मोड़ से दाईं ओर मुड़िए।
items.gu: આ રસ્તે સીધા જાઓ અને બીજા વળાંકથી જમણી બાજુ વળો.
items.why: Verbs of movement take を for the space moved through (道を行く, 角を曲がる) and に for the direction (右に曲がる).
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: 東京ドーム（ ）（ ）試合は、3対1（ ）負けた。
items.qr: Toukyou Doomu ( )( ) shiai wa, san tai ichi ( ) maketa.
items.en: We lost the game at Tokyo Dome 3 to 1.
items.hi: टोक्यो डोम में हुआ मैच हम 3–1 से हार गए।
items.gu: ટોક્યો ડોમમાં થયેલી મેચ અમે 3–1થી હારી ગયા.
items.why: The game takes place at the Dome → で, and to modify 試合 you add の: ドームでの試合. に can never be followed by の. The score of a win/loss takes で.
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: 母（ ）（ ）プレゼントはカシミアのマフラーです。
items.qr: Haha ( )( ) purezento wa kashimia no mafuraa desu.
items.en: The present for my mother is a cashmere scarf.
items.hi: माँ के लिए तोहफ़ा कश्मीरी ऊन का मफ़लर है।
items.gu: મા માટેની ભેટ કાશ્મીરી ઊનનું મફલર છે.
items.why: The recipient (母に贈る) becomes 母への before a noun, because に + の is impossible. 母との would mean "with my mother".
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: 試験（ ）合格するように、朝食（ ）カツどんを食べた。
items.qr: Shiken ( ) goukaku suru you ni, choushoku ( ) katsudon o tabeta.
items.en: I ate katsudon for breakfast so that I'd pass the exam.
items.hi: परीक्षा में पास होने के लिए मैंने नाश्ते में कत्सुडॉन खाया।
items.gu: પરીક્ષામાં પાસ થવા માટે મેં નાસ્તામાં કાત્સુડોન ખાધું.
items.why: 合格する takes に (試験に合格する — a very common learner error is ×試験を合格する). Meal + に = "for (that meal)". (Book's note: カツどん is a pork cutlet simmered and put on rice — eaten before exams because カツ sounds like 勝つ "win"; the pun is added, not in book.)
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: ＿＿＿ので、メモをしておきました。
items.qr: ___ node, memo o shite okimashita.
items.en: I wrote a memo in case I forget.
items.hi: कहीं भूल न जाऊँ, इसलिए मैंने नोट कर लिया।
items.gu: ક્યાંક ભૂલી ન જાઉં, એટલે મેં નોંધ કરી લીધી.
items.why: The bad thing to prevent is forgetting, so the affirmative verb goes before といけない: 忘れるといけないので = 忘れないように. 忘れないといけない would mean "I have to forget" (〜ないといけない = must); 忘れてはいけない is a prohibition, not a precaution.
items.unit: その他の基本文法① · 助詞・というのは・といけない

items.q: あの日はたまたま一台早い電車に乗った。いつもの電車に乗って＿＿＿、こんな事故には遭わなかっただろうに。
items.qr: Ano hi wa tamatama ichidai hayai densha ni notta. Itsumo no densha ni notte ___, konna jiko ni wa awanakatta darou ni.
items.en: That day I happened to catch a train one earlier than usual. If I had been on my usual train, I wouldn't have been in an accident like this.
items.hi: उस दिन मैं संयोग से एक ट्रेन पहले वाली में चढ़ गया। अगर मैं अपनी रोज़ की ट्रेन में होता, तो ऐसी दुर्घटना में न फँसता।
items.gu: એ દિવસે હું સંજોગવશાત્ એક ટ્રેન વહેલી પકડી બેઠો. જો રોજની ટ્રેનમાં હોત, તો આવા અકસ્માતમાં ન ફસાયો હોત.
items.why: Counterfactual past (review point 1): he did not take the usual train, so "if I had taken it" → 乗っていたら + 遭わなかっただろうに. 〜と is for general or habitual results, not a past what-if; いなくては means "must".
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: あなたが注意してくれなかったら、もう少しで傘を忘れる＿＿＿。
items.qr: Anata ga chuui shite kurenakattara, mou sukoshi de kasa o wasureru ___.
items.en: If you hadn't reminded me, I would very nearly have forgotten my umbrella.
items.hi: अगर तुमने याद न दिलाया होता, तो मैं छाता भूलने ही वाला था।
items.gu: જો તેં યાદ ન દેવડાવ્યું હોત, તો હું છત્રી ભૂલી જ જાત.
items.why: もう少しで + V-dictionary + ところだった = a near-miss in the past (review point 2). 〜ところではない means "this is no situation for ~" (どころではない-like), and ところだろう is a present guess.
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: この仕事は、大変なわりに給料が安いので、＿＿＿とても続かないでしょう。
items.qr: Kono shigoto wa, taihen na wari ni kyuuryou ga yasui node, ___ totemo tsuzukanai deshou.
items.en: This job is hard for the low pay, so unless you really like it, you probably won't last.
items.hi: यह काम मेहनत के मुक़ाबले कम तनख़्वाह वाला है, इसलिए अगर पसंद न हो तो ज़्यादा दिन नहीं टिक पाओगे।
items.gu: આ કામ મહેનતના પ્રમાણમાં ઓછા પગારવાળું છે, તેથી જો ગમતું ન હોય તો લાંબો સમય ટકી નહીં શકો.

opts.en: even if you don't like it

items.why: The result is negative (とても続かない), so the condition must be "unless" → 好きでなければ (review point 3). 好きだったら would need a positive result; 好きでなくても contradicts the logic.
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: あと2、3分早く家を＿＿＿、遅刻しないですんだのに。
items.qr: Ato ni, san-pun hayaku ie o ___, chikoku shinai de sunda no ni.
items.en: If I had left home two or three minutes earlier, I wouldn't have been late.
items.hi: अगर दो-तीन मिनट पहले घर से निकला होता, तो देर न होती।
items.gu: જો બે-ત્રણ મિનિટ વહેલો ઘરેથી નીકળ્યો હોત, તો મોડું ન થાત.
items.why: He was late, so he did not leave early: the what-if is affirmative → 出ていたら (model answer). The book notes ば／なら also work (出ていれば). 出なかったら reverses the logic.
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: 彼があんなことを言＿＿＿、今でも友達でいただろう。
items.qr: Kare ga anna koto o i___, ima demo tomodachi de ita darou.
items.en: If he hadn't said that sort of thing, we would probably still be friends now.
items.hi: अगर उसने वैसी बात न कही होती, तो हम आज भी दोस्त होते।
items.gu: જો એણે એવી વાત ન કહી હોત, તો અમે આજે પણ મિત્રો હોત.
items.why: He did say it and the friendship ended, so the counterfactual is negative → 言わなかったら (model answer). Note the blank starts after the kanji 言, so the answer is the kana tail わなかったら.
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: 「それは、お菓子じゃありません、薬です。」「なんだ、もう少しで＿＿＿よ。」
items.qr: "Sore wa, okashi ja arimasen, kusuri desu." "Nanda, mou sukoshi de ___ yo."
items.en: "That's not a sweet, it's medicine." "What? I nearly ate it!"
items.hi: "वह मिठाई नहीं, दवा है।" "अरे, मैं तो उसे खाने ही वाला था!"
items.gu: "એ મીઠાઈ નથી, દવા છે." "અરે, હું તો એને ખાવાનો જ હતો!"

opts.t: 食べるところではなかった

items.why: もう少しで + V-dictionary + ところだった → 食べるところだった (model answer). 食べたところ would mean he had already eaten it — not a near-miss.
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: 幼稚園の先生は、やはり子供が＿＿＿できないでしょうね。
items.qr: Youchien no sensei wa, yahari kodomo ga ___ dekinai deshou ne.
items.en: You probably can't be a kindergarten teacher unless you really like children.
items.hi: किंडरगार्टन की टीचर बनना बच्चों से प्यार न हो तो शायद मुमकिन नहीं।
items.gu: બાલમંદિરના શિક્ષક બનવું બાળકો ગમતાં ન હોય તો કદાચ શક્ય નથી.
items.why: The result できない is negative, so the condition is "unless": 好きでなければ (model answer). This is the same logic as test item 3.
items.unit: その他の基本文法②

items.q: 今度のスピーチコンテストでは、日本での経験＿＿＿話すつもりです。
items.qr: Kondo no supiichi kontesuto de wa, Nihon de no keiken ___ hanasu tsumori desu.
items.en: At the upcoming speech contest, I plan to talk about my experiences in Japan.
items.hi: आने वाली भाषण प्रतियोगिता में मैं जापान में अपने अनुभवों के बारे में बोलने वाला हूँ।
items.gu: આવનારી વક્તૃત્વ સ્પર્ધામાં હું જાપાનના મારા અનુભવો વિશે બોલવાનો છું.
items.why: 話す needs its content — について. をめぐって needs a dispute among several parties (a single speaker giving a speech isn't one); に対して would make 経験 the target the speech is aimed at; によって would mean the talk varies by, or is done by means of, the experience.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: ランチタイムのメニューは、日に＿＿＿変わります。
items.qr: Ranchitaimu no menyuu wa, hi ni ___ kawarimasu.
items.en: The lunchtime menu changes from day to day.
items.hi: लंच का मेन्यू दिन के हिसाब से बदलता है।
items.gu: બપોરના ભોજનનું મેનૂ દિવસ પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે.
items.why: The book prints the に, so the blank is just よって — and 変わります is the textbook signal for によって use (a), "varies by". The other three are all "about/toward" forms that make no sense with 変わる.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: この映画は掘り出された宝物＿＿＿登場人物が争うというストーリーだ。
items.qr: Kono eiga wa horidasareta takaramono ___ toujou jinbutsu ga arasou to iu sutoorii da.
items.en: This film is the story of characters fighting over a treasure that has been dug up.
items.hi: यह फ़िल्म खोदकर निकाले गए ख़ज़ाने को लेकर पात्रों के झगड़े की कहानी है।
items.gu: આ ફિલ્મ ખોદીને કાઢેલા ખજાનાને લઈને પાત્રો વચ્ચેના ઝઘડાની વાર્તા છે.
items.why: 争う (several characters fighting) is the classic partner of をめぐって — the treasure is the 争点. について is too neutral for a conflict; によって would make the treasure the cause or the agent; に対して would mean the characters fight against the treasure.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: あの子は小さい時に両親を亡くし、叔父夫婦＿＿＿育てられた。
items.qr: Ano ko wa chiisai toki ni ryoushin o nakushi, oji fuufu ___ sodaterareta.
items.en: That child lost both parents when small and was raised by an uncle and his wife.
items.hi: उस बच्चे ने छोटी उम्र में माता-पिता को खो दिया और उसे चाचा-चाची ने पाला।
items.gu: એ બાળકે નાની ઉંમરે માતાપિતા ગુમાવ્યાં અને તેને કાકા-કાકીએ ઉછેર્યું.
items.why: 育てられた is passive, so the blank marks who did the raising — によって use (d). None of the "about/toward/over" forms can mark a passive doer.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 苦手なことでも、何度も繰り返すこと＿＿＿自信をつけることができます。
items.qr: Nigate na koto demo, nando mo kurikaesu koto ___ jishin o tsukeru koto ga dekimasu.
items.en: Even with things you're bad at, you can build confidence by repeating them many times.
items.hi: जिन चीज़ों में आप कमज़ोर हैं, उन्हें भी बार-बार दोहराकर आप आत्मविश्वास बढ़ा सकते हैं।
items.gu: જે વસ્તુઓમાં તમે નબળા છો, તેને પણ વારંવાર દોહરાવીને તમે આત્મવિશ્વાસ મેળવી શકો છો.
items.why: Repetition is the method that builds confidence — によって use (b), "by means of" (V-plain + こと + によって). The others only introduce a topic or target and leave 自信をつける without a cause.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 彼の部屋の本箱には、政治＿＿＿本がたくさん並んでいた。
items.qr: Kare no heya no honbako ni wa, seiji ___ hon ga takusan narande ita.
items.en: The bookcase in his room was lined with lots of books on politics.
items.hi: उसके कमरे की किताबों की अलमारी में राजनीति से जुड़ी बहुत सारी किताबें रखी थीं।
items.gu: તેના રૂમના કબાટમાં રાજકારણ સંબંધિત ઘણાં પુસ્તકો ગોઠવેલાં હતાં.
items.why: The blank sits directly before the noun 本, so you need the noun-modifying form — に関する (see メモ). に関して is the same meaning but can't modify a noun; によって／に対して are wrong in both meaning and form. (政治についての本 would also be natural, but the key's answer is に関する.)
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 賃上げを求める労働組合＿＿＿、経営者側ははっきりとした回答を出さなかった。
items.qr: Chin'age o motomeru roudou kumiai ___, keieisha-gawa wa hakkiri to shita kaitou o dasanakatta.
items.en: Management gave no clear answer to the labour union demanding a pay rise.
items.hi: वेतन वृद्धि की माँग करने वाले मज़दूर संघ को प्रबंधन ने कोई स्पष्ट जवाब नहीं दिया।
items.gu: પગારવધારાની માગણી કરતા મજૂર સંઘને મેનેજમેન્ટે કોઈ સ્પષ્ટ જવાબ ન આપ્યો.
items.why: The union is the party the answer is directed at — に対して use (a). をめぐって needs an issue (賃上げをめぐって would work, but a group of people isn't an issue); について would make the union the topic of the answer; によって makes no sense here.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: うちの会社は土曜日は休みですが、場合＿＿＿出勤することもあります。
items.qr: Uchi no kaisha wa doyoubi wa yasumi desu ga, baai ___ shukkin suru koto mo arimasu.
items.en: Our company is closed on Saturdays, but in some cases we do come in to work.
items.hi: हमारी कंपनी में शनिवार को छुट्टी होती है, लेकिन कभी-कभी ज़रूरत पड़ने पर काम पर भी जाना पड़ता है।
items.gu: અમારી કંપનીમાં શનિવારે રજા હોય છે, પણ ક્યારેક જરૂર પડે તો કામ પર પણ જવું પડે છે.
items.why: "Normally X, but in some cases Y (〜こともある)" is exactly the によっては frame, and 場合によっては is a set phrase. によると needs a source + hearsay ending; に対しては／については would turn 場合 into a target/topic.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 最近は、ストレス＿＿＿体調不良で病院を訪れる人が多い。
items.qr: Saikin wa, sutoresu ___ taichou furyou de byouin o otozureru hito ga ooi.
items.en: These days many people visit hospitals with health problems caused by stress.
items.hi: आजकल तनाव से होने वाली तबीयत की ख़राबी के कारण बहुत लोग अस्पताल जाते हैं।
items.gu: આજકાલ તણાવથી થતી તબિયતની તકલીફને કારણે ઘણા લોકો હોસ્પિટલ જાય છે.
items.why: Stress is the cause (use c) and the blank is directly before the noun 体調不良, so the noun-modifying form による is needed. によって has the right meaning but the wrong shape before a noun; に対する／についての are noun-modifying but mean "toward / about".
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 何事にも慎重な兄＿＿＿、弟は失敗を恐れず行動する。
items.qr: Nanigoto ni mo shinchou na ani ___, otouto wa shippai o osorezu koudou suru.
items.en: Whereas the older brother is cautious about everything, the younger brother acts without fear of failure.
items.hi: बड़ा भाई हर काम में सावधान रहता है, जबकि छोटा भाई असफलता से डरे बिना काम करता है।
items.gu: મોટો ભાઈ દરેક બાબતમાં સાવચેત રહે છે, જ્યારે નાનો ભાઈ નિષ્ફળતાથી ડર્યા વગર કામ કરે છે.
items.why: Two people with opposite traits are set side by side — に対して use (b), contrast. The trap: here に対して attaches to a noun (兄), not to 〜の as in the book's examples, but the opposing pair 慎重 ↔ 失敗を恐れず shows it is contrast, not target. The other forms give no contrast meaning.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 高層ビル建設＿＿＿、付近の住民の利害が対立している。
items.qr: Kousou biru kensetsu ___, fukin no juumin no rigai ga tairitsu shite iru.
items.en: The interests of nearby residents are in conflict over the construction of a high-rise building.
items.hi: ऊँची इमारत के निर्माण को लेकर आसपास के निवासियों के हित आपस में टकरा रहे हैं।
items.gu: ઊંચી ઇમારતના બાંધકામને લઈને આસપાસના રહેવાસીઓનાં હિતો અંદરોઅંદર ટકરાઈ રહ્યાં છે.
items.why: 対立している (interests clashing among several groups) is the strongest をめぐって signal. に対して would mean the residents are all against the building (that's 反対, not 対立 among them); について is too neutral for conflict; によって would make the construction a mere cause, losing the "issue at the centre" nuance the key wants.
items.unit: 第1日 · に関して・に対して・について・をめぐって・によって

items.q: 最初に立てた計画＿＿＿、作業を進めていきましょう。
items.qr: Saisho ni tateta keikaku ___, sagyou o susumete ikimashou.
items.en: Let's carry on with the work following the plan we drew up at the start.
items.hi: शुरू में बनाई गई योजना के मुताबिक़ काम आगे बढ़ाते हैं।
items.gu: શરૂઆતમાં બનાવેલી યોજના મુજબ કામ આગળ વધારીએ.
items.why: 最初に立てた計画 is a plan that already exists — exactly the book's gloss for に沿って (すでに存在しているもの…に合わせて). に応じて needs a varying condition (能力, 必要), not a fixed plan; に反して would mean working against the plan; に代わって would mean the work replaces the plan.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 病気の母＿＿＿、ごあいさつにまいりました。
items.qr: Byouki no haha ___, goaisatsu ni mairimashita.
items.en: I have come to pay my respects in place of my mother, who is ill.
items.hi: मैं अपनी बीमार माँ की ओर से अभिवादन करने आया हूँ।
items.gu: હું મારી બીમાર માતા વતી અભિવાદન કરવા આવ્યો છું.

opts.en: in place of / on behalf of

items.why: The mother would normally come but is ill, so the speaker stands in for her — に代わって. 病気の母として would make the speaker the sick mother herself; にとって needs an evaluation; に加えて would mean the speaker came as well as the mother, which contradicts 病気.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 犯罪とは、法律＿＿＿行為のことである。
items.qr: Hanzai to wa, houritsu ___ koui no koto de aru.
items.en: A crime is an act that violates the law.
items.hi: अपराध का मतलब है क़ानून का उल्लंघन करने वाला कृत्य।
items.gu: ગુનો એટલે કાયદાનો ભંગ કરતું કૃત્ય.
items.why: The blank is directly before the noun 行為, so the noun-modifying form is required — に反する (use b, violation). に反して has the right meaning but the wrong shape; に沿った would define crime as a law-abiding act; に代わる would mean "an act that replaces the law".
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 彼は歌手＿＿＿だけでなく、画家＿＿＿も有名です。
items.qr: Kare wa kashu ___ dake de naku, gaka ___ mo yuumei desu.
items.en: He is famous not only as a singer but also as a painter.
items.hi: वह सिर्फ़ गायक के रूप में ही नहीं, बल्कि चित्रकार के रूप में भी प्रसिद्ध है।
items.gu: તે માત્ર ગાયક તરીકે જ નહીં, ચિત્રકાર તરીકે પણ પ્રખ્યાત છે.
items.why: Singer and painter are two roles he has — として in both blanks (the key gives 「として・として」). にとって would mean "famous from a singer's viewpoint"; に比べて would compare him with singers; に加えて can't be followed by だけでなく (it already means "in addition").
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 仕事を持つ女性の増加＿＿＿育児環境の悪さもあって、少子化が進んでいる。
items.qr: Shigoto o motsu josei no zouka ___ ikuji kankyou no warusa mo atte, shoushika ga susunde iru.
items.en: On top of the rise in the number of working women, the poor child-rearing environment also plays a part, and the birth rate keeps falling.
items.hi: कामकाजी महिलाओं की बढ़ती संख्या के साथ-साथ बच्चों की परवरिश का ख़राब माहौल भी है, इसलिए जन्म दर घटती जा रही है।
items.gu: નોકરી કરતી સ્ત્રીઓની વધતી સંખ્યા ઉપરાંત બાળઉછેરનું ખરાબ વાતાવરણ પણ છે, તેથી જન્મદર ઘટતો જાય છે.
items.why: Two causes are stacked up and the second one has も (悪さもあって) — the classic に加えて frame. に比べて would need a comparative; に応じて would mean the bad environment varies with the increase; に代わって would mean one cause replaced the other.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: A大学＿＿＿B大学は、留学生を受け入れる環境が整っている。
items.qr: A-daigaku ___ B-daigaku wa, ryuugakusei o ukeireru kankyou ga totonotte iru.
items.en: Compared with University A, University B is better set up to accept international students.
items.hi: A विश्वविद्यालय की तुलना में B विश्वविद्यालय में विदेशी छात्रों को स्वीकार करने की बेहतर व्यवस्था है।
items.gu: A યુનિવર્સિટીની સરખામણીમાં B યુનિવર્સિટીમાં વિદેશી વિદ્યાર્થીઓને સ્વીકારવાની વધુ સારી વ્યવસ્થા છે.
items.why: Two universities are measured against each other on one quality (整っている) — に比べて. に加えて would need も (B大学も); に代わって would mean B replaces A; A大学にとって would mean "from A's viewpoint, B is well equipped", which is not the point.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 100年前の人たち＿＿＿飛行機で外国に行くことは夢のような話だっただろう。
items.qr: Hyaku-nen mae no hitotachi ___ hikouki de gaikoku ni iku koto wa yume no you na hanashi datta darou.
items.en: For people 100 years ago, flying abroad must have sounded like a dream.
items.hi: 100 साल पहले के लोगों के लिए हवाई जहाज़ से विदेश जाना किसी सपने जैसी बात रही होगी।
items.gu: 100 વર્ષ પહેલાંના લોકો માટે વિમાનમાં વિદેશ જવું એ સપના જેવી વાત રહી હશે.
items.why: 夢のような話だった is an evaluation judged from those people's viewpoint — にとって. として would make "people of 100 years ago" a role; に比べて would need a comparison; に代わって makes no sense.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 税金は、収入＿＿＿決められる。
items.qr: Zeikin wa, shuunyuu ___ kimerareru.
items.en: Taxes are set according to income.
items.hi: कर आमदनी के अनुसार तय किए जाते हैं।
items.gu: કર આવકના આધારે નક્કી થાય છે.
items.why: Income is a variable that differs person to person, and the tax changes to match — に応じて (cf. book example 1: 能力に応じて決められる). Income is not a wish (にこたえて) nor a laid-down plan (に沿って); に比べて would need a comparative.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 社員の期待＿＿＿、ボーナスは昨年度を下回った。
items.qr: Shain no kitai ___, boonasu wa sakunendo o shitamawatta.
items.en: Contrary to the employees' expectations, the bonus fell below last year's.
items.hi: कर्मचारियों की उम्मीदों के विपरीत, बोनस पिछले साल से भी कम रहा।
items.gu: કર્મચારીઓની અપેક્ષાથી વિપરીત, બોનસ ગયા વર્ષ કરતાં પણ ઓછું રહ્યું.
items.why: The bonus fell (下回った) — the opposite of what the staff hoped, so に反して (use a). 期待にこたえて is a very common collocation, which is the trap: it would mean the company fulfilled the expectation, contradicting 下回った. に応じて／に沿って likewise imply the result matched the hope.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 視聴者のリクエスト＿＿＿、あの番組を再放送することにした。
items.qr: Shichousha no rikuesuto ___, ano bangumi o saihousou suru koto ni shita.
items.en: In response to viewers' requests, we decided to rebroadcast that programme.
items.hi: दर्शकों की फ़रमाइश पर हमने उस कार्यक्रम को दोबारा प्रसारित करने का फ़ैसला किया।
items.gu: દર્શકોની વિનંતીના જવાબમાં અમે એ કાર્યક્રમ ફરી પ્રસારિત કરવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.
items.why: A リクエスト is a wish, and rebroadcasting fulfils it — にこたえて. (リクエストに応じて also exists in real Japanese, "complying with a request", but the key's answer is にこたえて because the book teaches に応じて as "matching a variable".) に反して would mean ignoring the request; に代わって would make the viewers the ones normally broadcasting.
items.unit: 第2日

items.q: 働く女性の増加＿＿＿、外食産業が発展した。
items.qr: Hataraku josei no zouka ___, gaishoku sangyou ga hatten shita.
items.en: Along with the increase in working women, the restaurant industry has grown.
items.hi: कामकाजी महिलाओं की बढ़ती संख्या के साथ-साथ बाहर खाने का उद्योग भी फला-फूला।
items.gu: નોકરી કરતી સ્ત્રીઓની વધતી સંખ્યાની સાથે સાથે બહાર જમવાનો ઉદ્યોગ પણ વિકસ્યો.
items.why: A change noun (増加) leads to another change (発展した) — に伴って, the formal "change → change" link that attaches to nouns. に基づいて needs a foundation (data, facts); において needs a place/field; にあたって needs an upcoming event plus a preparatory act.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 二人の結婚披露宴は、ニュープリンスホテル＿＿＿行われることになった。
items.qr: Futari no kekkon hirouen wa, Nyuu Purinsu Hoteru ___ okonawareru koto ni natta.
items.en: It has been decided that the couple's wedding reception will be held at the New Prince Hotel.
items.hi: तय हुआ है कि दोनों का विवाह-भोज न्यू प्रिंस होटल में होगा।
items.gu: નક્કી થયું છે કે બંનેનો લગ્ન-સમારંભ ન્યૂ પ્રિન્સ હોટલમાં યોજાશે.
items.why: A hotel is the venue where an event is held (行われる) — において, a formal で. における is the noun-modifying shape (wrong before a verb); にあたって attaches to events, not places; とともに would make the hotel a co-participant.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: この小説は、史実＿＿＿書かれています。
items.qr: Kono shousetsu wa, shijitsu ___ kakarete imasu.
items.en: This novel is written based on historical fact.
items.hi: यह उपन्यास ऐतिहासिक तथ्यों के आधार पर लिखा गया है।
items.gu: આ નવલકથા ઐતિહાસિક તથ્યોના આધારે લખાઈ છે.
items.why: Historical fact is the foundation the novel is built on — に基づいて (cf. book example 1: 事件に基づいて作られた). に即して suits adapting to a current situation (現状), not the source of a story; において treats 史実 as a place; につれて needs change.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 学校では、知識を身につける＿＿＿、社会性も養うことができる。
items.qr: Gakkou de wa, chishiki o mi ni tsukeru ___, shakaisei mo yashinau koto ga dekiru.
items.en: At school you can acquire knowledge and, at the same time, develop social skills.
items.hi: स्कूल में ज्ञान हासिल करने के साथ-साथ सामाजिकता भी विकसित की जा सकती है।
items.gu: શાળામાં જ્ઞાન મેળવવાની સાથે સાથે સામાજિકતા પણ કેળવી શકાય છે.
items.why: Two benefits held together, with も on the second (社会性も) — とともに use (a), like 喜びであるとともに寂しくもある. につれて would need proportional change; にあたって would make knowledge-acquiring a future event you prepare for; に基づいて doesn't fit a verb clause here.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 理想ばかり追わずに、もっと現実＿＿＿考えた方がいい。
items.qr: Risou bakari owazu ni, motto genjitsu ___ kangaeta hou ga ii.
items.en: Rather than chasing ideals all the time, you'd better think more in line with reality.
items.hi: सिर्फ़ आदर्शों के पीछे भागने के बजाय, वास्तविकता के अनुरूप ज़्यादा सोचना बेहतर है।
items.gu: ફક્ત આદર્શો પાછળ દોડવાને બદલે, વાસ્તવિકતાને અનુરૂપ વધુ વિચારવું સારું.
items.why: 現実 is the reality-type noun that に即して (N1) pairs with, set against 理想. に基づいて ("based on reality") is grammatical but the book's key chooses に即して — the nuance is "stay close to how things actually are". において would mean "think while inside reality"; とともに "think together with reality" makes no sense.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 現代＿＿＿最も深刻な問題の一つに、環境問題があげられる。
items.qr: Gendai ___ mottomo shinkoku na mondai no hitotsu ni, kankyou mondai ga agerareru.
items.en: Environmental issues can be named as one of the most serious problems of the present age.
items.hi: आधुनिक युग की सबसे गंभीर समस्याओं में से एक के रूप में पर्यावरण की समस्या गिनाई जा सकती है।
items.gu: આધુનિક યુગની સૌથી ગંભીર સમસ્યાઓમાંની એક તરીકે પર્યાવરણની સમસ્યા ગણાવી શકાય.
items.why: 現代 is a time/era, and the blank modifies the noun phrase 最も深刻な問題 — so the noun-modifying form における (cf. 20世紀における最大の発明). において is the right meaning in the wrong shape; に伴う／に即した don't fit an era noun.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 出発＿＿＿、もう一度持ち物のチェックをした。
items.qr: Shuppatsu ___, mou ichido mochimono no chekku o shita.
items.en: Before setting off, I checked my belongings once more.
items.hi: रवाना होने से पहले मैंने एक बार फिर अपना सामान जाँचा।
items.gu: નીકળતાં પહેલાં મેં ફરી એક વાર મારો સામાન તપાસ્યો.
items.why: Departure is an upcoming event and checking belongings is a preparation for it — にあたって. 出発とともに would mean "at the moment of departure"; に伴って needs a change; において treats 出発 as a place.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 北国では、雪解け＿＿＿春がやってくる。
items.qr: Kitaguni de wa, yukidoke ___ haru ga yatte kuru.
items.en: In the snow country of the north, spring arrives with the thaw.
items.hi: उत्तरी इलाक़ों में बर्फ़ पिघलने के साथ ही वसंत आ जाता है।
items.gu: ઉત્તરના પ્રદેશોમાં બરફ ઓગળવાની સાથે જ વસંત આવી જાય છે.
items.why: The thaw and spring's arrival happen at the same moment — とともに use (b), like 夜明けとともに. にあたって needs a human preparation; において treats 雪解け as a place; に基づいて makes no sense.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: この土地での生活に慣れるにつれて、｛a 友達がたくさんいる。／ b 友達が増えてきた。｝
items.qr: Kono tochi de no seikatsu ni nareru ni tsurete, {a tomodachi ga takusan iru. / b tomodachi ga fuete kita.}
items.en: As I've got used to life here, I've made more and more friends.
items.hi: जैसे-जैसे मुझे यहाँ की ज़िंदगी की आदत पड़ी, मेरे दोस्त बढ़ते गए।
items.gu: જેમ જેમ મને અહીંના જીવનની ટેવ પડી, તેમ તેમ મારા મિત્રો વધતા ગયા.
items.why: につれて requires a change in the main clause to match the change before it. 増えてきた is a gradual change ✓; たくさんいる is a static state ✗.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 郊外に大規模なショッピングセンターを建設するにあたって、｛a まず付近の道路を整備した。／ b 有名店がたくさん入る予定だ。｝
items.qr: Kougai ni daikibo na shoppingu sentaa o kensetsu suru ni atatte, {a mazu fukin no douro o seibi shita. / b yuumeiten ga takusan hairu yotei da.}
items.en: In preparation for building a large shopping centre in the suburbs, they first improved the nearby roads.
items.hi: उपनगर में बड़ा शॉपिंग सेंटर बनाने से पहले उन्होंने सबसे पहले आसपास की सड़कें ठीक कीं।
items.gu: ઉપનગરમાં મોટું શૉપિંગ સેન્ટર બાંધતાં પહેલાં તેમણે સૌપ્રથમ આસપાસના રસ્તા સુધાર્યા.

opts.t: まず付近の道路を整備した。
opts.r: Mazu fukin no douro o seibi shita.
opts.en: They first improved the nearby roads.
opts.hi: पहले आसपास की सड़कें ठीक कीं।

opts.t: 有名店がたくさん入る予定だ。
opts.r: Yuumeiten ga takusan hairu yotei da.
opts.en: Many famous shops are due to open there.
opts.hi: कई मशहूर दुकानें खुलने वाली हैं।

items.why: にあたって must be followed by a preparatory act for the upcoming event (cf. まず部屋を探した, まず…スタッフを送り出した). Improving the roads is preparation ✓; "famous shops will move in" is merely a fact about the finished centre ✗.
items.unit: 第3日

items.q: 彼は試合に勝つため＿＿＿、どんな汚い手も使うだろう。
items.qr: Kare wa shiai ni katsu tame ___, donna kitanai te mo tsukau darou.
items.en: If it's to win the match, he'll probably use any dirty trick there is.
items.hi: मैच जीतने के लिए वह कोई भी गंदी चाल चल देगा।
items.gu: મેચ જીતવા માટે તે ગમે તેવી ગંદી ચાલ પણ ચાલશે.
items.why: 〜ため + "any dirty trick" is the とあれば frame: a purpose that justifies going to any length (cf. 当選するためとあれば、実行不可能な公約もする). とあって states a fact-reason and an observed result, not a willingness; にあって needs a situation noun; あっての needs a noun after it.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 妻が家出する＿＿＿初めて、夫は家庭を顧みることの大切さに気づいた。
items.qr: Tsuma ga iede suru ___ hajimete, otto wa katei o kaerimiru koto no taisetsusa ni kizuita.
items.en: Only when it came to his wife leaving home did the husband realise how important it is to pay attention to one's family.
items.hi: पत्नी के घर छोड़कर चले जाने की नौबत आने पर ही पति को परिवार पर ध्यान देने की अहमियत समझ आई।
items.gu: પત્ની ઘર છોડી ગઈ ત્યારે જ પતિને કુટુંબનું ધ્યાન રાખવાનું મહત્ત્વ સમજાયું.
items.why: A serious development (妻が家出する) + 初めて + a belated realisation — the に至って pattern (cf. 自殺者が出るに至って初めて). に至っては is a topic marker for nouns, not followed by 初めて; とあって gives an observed reaction, not a late realisation; にわたって needs a span.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 最近では、会社＿＿＿自分だ、と考えるような会社人間は少なくなってきた。
items.qr: Saikin de wa, kaisha ___ jibun da, to kangaeru you na kaisha ningen wa sukunaku natte kita.
items.en: These days there are fewer "company men" who think, "I only exist because of the company."
items.hi: आजकल ऐसे "कंपनी-भक्त" कम होते जा रहे हैं जो सोचते हैं कि "मेरा अस्तित्व कंपनी की वजह से ही है"।
items.gu: આજકાલ એવા "કંપની-ભક્ત" ઓછા થતા જાય છે જે વિચારે કે "મારું અસ્તિત્વ કંપનીને લીધે જ છે".
items.why: Noun + ＿ + noun (会社＿自分) in the sense "I am possible only thanks to the company" — N₁あってのN₂. The ある-family distractors either don't link two nouns (とあって) or mean "in a situation" (にあって); に至る would describe a route.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: この店は、ブランド品が格安で買える＿＿＿、いつも女性客で賑わっている。
items.qr: Kono mise wa, burando-hin ga kakuyasu de kaeru ___, itsumo josei-kyaku de nigiwatte iru.
items.en: Since you can buy brand-name goods at bargain prices here, this shop is always bustling with women customers.
items.hi: चूँकि यहाँ ब्रांडेड सामान बहुत सस्ते में मिलता है, इसलिए यह दुकान हमेशा महिला ग्राहकों से भरी रहती है।
items.gu: અહીં બ્રાન્ડેડ માલ ખૂબ સસ્તામાં મળતો હોવાથી આ દુકાન હંમેશાં મહિલા ગ્રાહકોથી ધમધમે છે.
items.why: A special circumstance (brand goods at bargain prices) → an observed scene (always crowded) — とあって. とあれば is conditional and needs a "will do anything" clause; にあって needs a situation noun, not a verb clause; に至って would need a dramatic, belated reaction.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 今度の台風は九州から近畿地方＿＿＿の広い範囲＿＿＿かなりの被害をもたらした。
items.qr: Kondo no taifuu wa Kyuushuu kara Kinki chihou ___ no hiroi han'i ___ kanari no higai o motarashita.
items.en: This typhoon caused considerable damage over a wide area stretching from Kyushu to the Kinki region.
items.hi: इस तूफ़ान ने क्यूशू से किंकी क्षेत्र तक के विशाल इलाक़े में भारी नुक़सान पहुँचाया।
items.gu: આ વાવાઝોડાએ ક્યૂશૂથી કિંકી વિસ્તાર સુધીના વિશાળ પ્રદેશમાં ભારે નુકસાન કર્યું.

opts.t: にかけて・にわたって
にわたって・にかけて

items.why: Blank 1 follows 九州から… and precedes の — the から…にかけて(の) range. Blank 2 follows the single noun 広い範囲 and stresses the extent of the damage — にわたって. Reversing them fails because にわたって doesn't pair with から, and に至って means "only when it came to".
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 最近の子供は友達と外で元気に遊ぶことがとても少なくなった。ひどい子＿＿＿暇さえあれば一人でゲームをしている。
items.qr: Saikin no kodomo wa tomodachi to soto de genki ni asobu koto ga totemo sukunaku natta. Hidoi ko ___ hima sae areba hitori de geemu o shite iru.
items.en: Children these days very rarely play energetically outside with friends. The worst of them play video games alone whenever they have a free moment.
items.hi: आजकल बच्चे दोस्तों के साथ बाहर खेलना बहुत कम करते हैं। सबसे बुरे बच्चे तो ज़रा-सी फ़ुरसत मिलते ही अकेले गेम खेलने लगते हैं।
items.gu: આજકાલનાં બાળકો મિત્રો સાથે બહાર રમવાનું બહુ ઓછું કરે છે. સૌથી ખરાબ બાળકો તો જરાક ફુરસદ મળતાં જ એકલાં ગેમ રમવા બેસી જાય છે.
items.why: A general bad trend is described, then the most extreme case is singled out with ひどい子 — に至っては (exactly like ひどい学生に至っては in the book). に至って would need a belated reaction (初めて); にあって／とあって don't mark "the worst example".
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: この物の豊かな時代＿＿＿、子供に物を大切にすることを教えるのは難しい。
items.qr: Kono mono no yutaka na jidai ___, kodomo ni mono o taisetsu ni suru koto o oshieru no wa muzukashii.
items.en: In this age of material abundance, it is hard to teach children to take care of things.
items.hi: भौतिक समृद्धि के इस दौर में बच्चों को चीज़ों की क़द्र करना सिखाना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: ભૌતિક સમૃદ્ધિના આ યુગમાં બાળકોને વસ્તુઓની કદર કરતાં શીખવવું મુશ્કેલ છે.
items.why: 時代 is a situation/era and the main clause states a difficulty within it — にあって (cf. 情報の洪水の中にあって…大変だ). とあって would require an observed reaction, not 難しい; あっての needs a following noun; にわたって would stress the length of the era, which isn't the point.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 週刊誌は急に有名になった彼女の私生活から過去の秘密＿＿＿まで書き立てた。
items.qr: Shuukanshi wa kyuu ni yuumei ni natta kanojo no shiseikatsu kara kako no himitsu ___ made kakitateta.
items.en: The weekly magazines splashed everything about her, newly famous as she was — from her private life right down to the secrets of her past.
items.hi: साप्ताहिक पत्रिकाओं ने अचानक मशहूर हुई उस महिला की निजी ज़िंदगी से लेकर उसके अतीत के राज़ तक सब कुछ छाप दिया।
items.gu: સાપ્તાહિક સામયિકોએ અચાનક પ્રસિદ્ધ થયેલી તે સ્ત્રીના અંગત જીવનથી માંડીને તેના ભૂતકાળનાં રહસ્યો સુધી બધું છાપી નાખ્યું.
items.why: まで is already printed, and the pattern is AからBに至るまで — "from A all the way to (the surprising) B". にかけて is for time/space ranges and doesn't combine with まで; にわたる needs a following noun; に至って + まで isn't a pattern.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 10年間＿＿＿民族紛争に、やっと終止符が打たれた。
items.qr: Juu-nenkan ___ minzoku funsou ni, yatto shuushifu ga utareta.
items.en: The ethnic conflict that had dragged on for ten years was finally brought to an end.
items.hi: दस साल तक चले जातीय संघर्ष पर आख़िरकार विराम लग गया।
items.gu: દસ વર્ષ સુધી ચાલેલા વંશીય સંઘર્ષનો આખરે અંત આવ્યો.
items.why: A duration (10年間) directly modifying the noun 民族紛争 — the noun form にわたる (cf. 20年にわたる研究). にわたって has the right meaning but the wrong shape; に至る would mean "the conflict reaching 10 years"; にかけての needs a から partner.
items.unit: 第4日

items.q: 彼は優秀な成績＿＿＿この学校を卒業した。
items.qr: Kare wa yuushuu na seiseki ___ kono gakkou o sotsugyou shita.
items.en: He graduated from this school with excellent grades.
items.hi: उसने उत्कृष्ट अंकों के साथ इस स्कूल से स्नातक किया।
items.gu: તે ઉત્તમ ગુણ સાથે આ શાળામાંથી ઉત્તીર્ણ થયો.

opts.hi: की तो बात ही मत करो
opts.gu: ની તો વાત જ ન કરો

items.why: The grades are the formal means/record with which he graduated — をもって (formal で). を込めて needs a feeling; と相まって needs two factors combining; ときたら would turn his grades into a complaint.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: 皆さんに応援していただいたこの番組も、今回＿＿＿終了させていただきます。
items.qr: Minasan ni ouen shite itadaita kono bangumi mo, konkai ___ shuuryou sasete itadakimasu.
items.en: This programme, which you have all so kindly supported, will come to an end with this episode.
items.hi: आप सबके समर्थन से चला यह कार्यक्रम इस प्रसारण के साथ समाप्त हो रहा है।
items.gu: આપ સૌના સમર્થનથી ચાલેલો આ કાર્યક્રમ આ પ્રસારણ સાથે સમાપ્ત થાય છે.
items.why: A formal end-point announcement with 終了 — 今回をもって, exactly like 本日をもって閉店. たりとも needs 一〜 and a negative; を込めて needs a feeling noun; というより makes no sense with 今回.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: このレストランでは、肉本来の味と香辛料の香りが＿＿＿た独特のおいしい料理を味わうことができます。
items.qr: Kono resutoran de wa, niku honrai no aji to koushinryou no kaori ga ___ ta dokutoku no oishii ryouri o ajiwau koto ga dekimasu.
items.en: At this restaurant you can enjoy unique, delicious dishes in which the natural flavour of the meat combines with the aroma of spices.
items.hi: इस रेस्तराँ में आप ऐसे अनोखे, स्वादिष्ट व्यंजन चख सकते हैं जिनमें मांस का असली स्वाद और मसालों की ख़ुशबू एक साथ घुल-मिल जाते हैं।
items.gu: આ રેસ્ટોરાંમાં તમે એવી અનોખી, સ્વાદિષ્ટ વાનગીઓ માણી શકો છો જેમાં માંસનો મૂળ સ્વાદ અને મસાલાની સુગંધ એકરસ થઈ જાય છે.
items.why: Two factors (taste and aroma, joined by と…が) blending into one effect (独特のおいしい料理) — と相まって, here in the past noun-modifying form 相まった. The key prints 「相まっ(た)」 because た is already on the page. 込めた needs a feeling; もった doesn't express two things combining; ときた would not be this pattern at all.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: 彼の食べ方は本当に早い。食べている＿＿＿飲み込んでいるといった感じだ。
items.qr: Kare no tabekata wa hontou ni hayai. Tabete iru ___ nomikonde iru to itta kanji da.
items.en: He eats really fast. It's less eating than swallowing.
items.hi: वह सच में बहुत तेज़ खाता है। खाना कम, निगलना ज़्यादा लगता है।
items.gu: તે ખરેખર બહુ ઝડપથી ખાય છે. ખાવા કરતાં ગળી જવા જેવું વધુ લાગે છે.
items.why: 食べている is replaced by a more fitting word, 飲み込んでいる, + といった感じだ — the というより correction frame (cf. 歌っているというより怒鳴っているって感じ). はもちろん／はおろか would mean he both eats and swallows; と相まって needs two nouns combining.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: 試験の日が近づいてきた。もう一日＿＿＿無駄にはできない。
items.qr: Shiken no hi ga chikazuite kita. Mou ichinichi ___ muda ni wa dekinai.
items.en: The exam date is getting close. I can't waste a single day more.
items.hi: परीक्षा का दिन नज़दीक आ गया है। अब एक दिन भी बर्बाद नहीं कर सकता।
items.gu: પરીક્ષાનો દિવસ નજીક આવી ગયો છે. હવે એક દિવસ પણ વેડફી શકાય નહીં.
items.why: 一日 (one + counter) + a negative (無駄にはできない) — the たりとも…ない frame. をもって would read "as of one day"; はおろか needs a second item with も; ときたら needs a complaint target.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: 5月5日には、男の子が強く育つようにという願い＿＿＿五月人形を飾ります。
items.qr: Gogatsu itsuka ni wa, otoko no ko ga tsuyoku sodatsu you ni to iu negai ___ gogatsu ningyou o kazarimasu.
items.en: On 5 May, people display May dolls, with the wish that their boys will grow up strong.
items.hi: 5 मई को लड़कों के मज़बूत बनकर बड़े होने की कामना के साथ "मई की गुड़ियाँ" सजाई जाती हैं।
items.gu: 5 મેના રોજ છોકરાઓ મજબૂત બનીને મોટા થાય એવી ઇચ્છા સાથે "મે મહિનાની ઢીંગલીઓ" શણગારાય છે.
items.why: 願い is a feeling/wish packed into the act of displaying the dolls — を込めて. をもって would make the wish a tool; と相まって needs two factors combining; というより would reject the wish.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: 現代の科学＿＿＿しても、解明できない謎はたくさんある。
items.qr: Gendai no kagaku ___ shite mo, kaimei dekinai nazo wa takusan aru.
items.en: There are many mysteries that even modern science can't explain.
items.hi: ऐसे बहुत से रहस्य हैं जिन्हें आधुनिक विज्ञान भी नहीं सुलझा सकता।
items.gu: એવાં ઘણાં રહસ્યો છે જે આધુનિક વિજ્ઞાન પણ ઉકેલી શકતું નથી.
items.why: しても is printed, so the blank completes 〜をもってしても — "even with modern science, it can't be explained" (cf. 彼の頭脳をもってしても解決できない). None of the others can combine with しても.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: あなたほどの実力＿＿＿すれば、合格は間違いないでしょう。
items.qr: Anata hodo no jitsuryoku ___ sureba, goukaku wa machigai nai deshou.
items.en: With ability like yours, you're sure to pass.
items.hi: आपकी जैसी क़ाबिलियत के बल पर तो आपका पास होना तय है।
items.gu: તમારા જેવી ક્ષમતાના બળે તો તમે ઉત્તીર્ણ થશો જ.
items.why: すれば is printed and the result is positive (合格は間違いない) — 〜をもってすれば, "if you use ~, success is certain" (cf. 皆の協力をもってすれば). The other forms can't take すれば.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: うちの主人＿＿＿休みの日には寝てばかりいて、何にもしてくれないんですよ。
items.qr: Uchi no shujin ___ yasumi no hi ni wa nete bakari ite, nan ni mo shite kurenai n desu yo.
items.en: My husband — on his days off he does nothing but sleep, and never helps with anything.
items.hi: मेरे पति की तो बात ही मत कीजिए — छुट्टी के दिन बस सोते रहते हैं, कुछ भी मदद नहीं करते।
items.gu: મારા પતિની તો વાત જ ન કરો — રજાના દિવસે બસ ઊંઘ્યા કરે છે, કંઈ પણ મદદ કરતા નથી.

opts.hi: की तो बात ही मत करो
opts.gu: ની તો વાત જ ન કરો

items.why: A close family member + an exasperated complaint (寝てばかり, 何にもしてくれない) — ときたら. はもちろん needs a second item with も; をもって is formal "by means of"; というより would correct the word 主人.
items.unit: 第5日

items.q: ハワイは一年＿＿＿暖かい。
items.qr: Hawai wa ichinen ___ atatakai.
items.en: Hawaii is warm all year round.
items.hi: हवाई पूरे साल गर्म रहता है।
items.gu: હવાઈ આખું વર્ષ ગરમ રહે છે.
items.why: 一年 is a period, and "warm through the whole of it" is を通じて use (a) (like 四季を通じて). The book reserves を通して for a go-between; 一年にもまして would compare with "a year"; のもとで needs an influencing person/thing.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: 彼女、今日も休んでいるけど、もうすぐ会社を辞める＿＿＿って話ですよ。
items.qr: Kanojo, kyou mo yasunde iru kedo, mou sugu kaisha o yameru ___ tte hanashi desu yo.
items.en: She's off again today — I heard something about her quitting the company soon.
items.hi: वह आज भी छुट्टी पर है — सुना है कि वह जल्द ही कंपनी छोड़ने वाली है।
items.gu: તે આજે પણ રજા પર છે — સાંભળ્યું છે કે તે જલદી કંપની છોડવાની છે.
items.why: 〜って話ですよ shows vague hearsay — the とか of uncertainty (cf. 移転したとかいう話よ). はともかく would need a following contrast; にして needs a person noun; にかかわる attaches to nouns like 命／信用.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: 世界最強の男と言われた彼＿＿＿、あの奥さんには頭が上がらなかったらしい。
items.qr: Sekai saikyou no otoko to iwareta kare ___, ano okusan ni wa atama ga agaranakatta rashii.
items.en: Apparently even he, who was called the strongest man in the world, could never stand up to that wife of his.
items.hi: सुना है कि दुनिया का सबसे ताक़तवर आदमी कहलाने वाला वह भी अपनी उस पत्नी के आगे सिर नहीं उठा पाता था।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે દુનિયાનો સૌથી તાકાતવાન માણસ કહેવાતો તે પણ પોતાની એ પત્ની સામે માથું ઊંચું કરી શકતો નહોતો.
items.why: An exceptional person (世界最強の男) + a failure (頭が上がらなかった) — にして use (b), "even such a person couldn't". にかけては needs a skill field + praise; のもとで would put the wife "under" him; 彼にもまして would compare him with another person.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: 入学試験に必要な書類は、学生課＿＿＿申し込んでください。
items.qr: Nyuugaku shiken ni hitsuyou na shorui wa, gakuseika ___ moushikonde kudasai.
items.en: Please apply for the documents needed for the entrance exam through the Student Affairs Office.
items.hi: प्रवेश परीक्षा के लिए ज़रूरी दस्तावेज़ों के लिए कृपया छात्र-कार्यालय के माध्यम से आवेदन करें।
items.gu: પ્રવેશ પરીક્ષા માટે જરૂરી દસ્તાવેજો માટે કૃપા કરી વિદ્યાર્થી કાર્યાલય મારફતે અરજી કરો.
items.why: 学生課 is an office acting as a go-between for your application — exactly the 秘書課を通して申し込んでください model, so the key gives を通して. を通じて can also mean "via" in real usage, but the book teaches it for periods and media; のもとで／にかけては make no sense with 申し込む.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: 彼女は前からきれいだったが、最近、以前＿＿＿きれいになってきた。
items.qr: Kanojo wa mae kara kirei datta ga, saikin, izen ___ kirei ni natte kita.
items.en: She was always pretty, but lately she has become even prettier than before.
items.hi: वह पहले से ही सुंदर थी, लेकिन हाल में पहले से भी ज़्यादा सुंदर हो गई है।
items.gu: તે પહેલેથી જ સુંદર હતી, પણ હમણાં પહેલાં કરતાં પણ વધુ સુંદર થઈ ગઈ છે.
items.why: The baseline (以前) was already high (前からきれいだった) and now it's surpassed — にもまして (cf. とても暑かった昨年にもまして暑い). 以前を通じて ("throughout the past") contradicts 最近; はともかく would dismiss her past looks; にかけては needs a skill field.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: あの選手は、厳しいコーチ＿＿＿猛練習を続け、見事金メダルを獲得した。
items.qr: Ano senshu wa, kibishii koochi ___ mourenshuu o tsuzuke, migoto kin medaru o kakutoku shita.
items.en: That athlete kept up gruelling training under a strict coach and splendidly won the gold medal.
items.hi: उस खिलाड़ी ने सख़्त कोच की देखरेख में कड़ा अभ्यास जारी रखा और शानदार ढंग से स्वर्ण पदक जीता।
items.gu: એ ખેલાડીએ કડક કોચના હાથ નીચે સખત અભ્યાસ ચાલુ રાખ્યો અને શાનદાર રીતે સુવર્ણ ચંદ્રક જીત્યો.
items.why: The athlete trained within the coach's sphere of influence/guidance — のもとで (cf. あの部長のもとで). を通して would make the coach a relay for the training; にして would make the coach the one achieving; にかけては needs a skill + praise.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: インターネット＿＿＿世界中の人と交信することができる。
items.qr: Intaanetto ___ sekaijuu no hito to koushin suru koto ga dekiru.
items.en: Through the internet you can communicate with people all over the world.
items.hi: इंटरनेट के ज़रिए दुनिया भर के लोगों से संपर्क किया जा सकता है।
items.gu: ઇન્ટરનેટ દ્વારા દુનિયાભરના લોકો સાથે સંપર્ક કરી શકાય છે.
items.why: The internet is a medium — を通じて use (b), like マスコミを通じて. (を通して would also be heard in real life, but the key gives を通じて.) のもとで, にかけても and にもまして have no "via" meaning.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: こんなにおもしろい旅行記は、長年にわたって世界中を旅し、いろいろな人と出会ってきた彼＿＿＿初めて書けるものだ。
items.qr: Konna ni omoshiroi ryokouki wa, naganen ni watatte sekaijuu o tabi shi, iroiro na hito to deatte kita kare ___ hajimete kakeru mono da.
items.en: A travelogue this interesting is something only he — who has travelled the world for years and met all kinds of people — could write.
items.hi: इतना दिलचस्प यात्रा-वृत्तांत वही लिख सकता है जिसने बरसों दुनिया भर में घूमकर तरह-तरह के लोगों से मुलाक़ात की हो।
items.gu: આટલું રસપ્રદ પ્રવાસવર્ણન એ જ લખી શકે જેણે વર્ષો સુધી દુનિયાભરમાં ફરીને જાતજાતના લોકોને મળ્યા હોય.
items.why: 初めて is printed and the subject is an exceptional person — 〜にして初めて書ける, use (a), "only someone like him". のもとで would put the writing under him; にかけては needs praise in the main clause; を通じて makes him a medium.
items.unit: 第6日

items.q: 校内暴力は、伝統あるわが校の名誉＿＿＿ことです。外部の人には絶対に知られないようにしてください。
items.qr: Kounai bouryoku wa, dentou aru waga kou no meiyo ___ koto desu. Gaibu no hito ni wa zettai ni shirarenai you ni shite kudasai.
